## Jobbie PR evidence contract

- **PR slot / phase:** P?-? (see `docs/PHASES.md`)
- **Base SHA / head SHA:**
- **Scope and behavior before -> after:**
- **Files/contracts changed:**
- **Test commands + literal results:**
- **Fixtures + negative/adversarial coverage:**
- **Actual live/source/workflow evidence (or BLOCKED_LIVE):**
- **Security/privacy check:** public diff contains no secrets/resumes/private code/contact info
- **Compatibility:** existing 13 original sources, state/CLI/webhook, earlier phases
- **Migration / backfill / rollback:**
- **Source licenses and allowed data access (if relevant):**
- **AI outputs verified against fact/evidence spans (if relevant):**
- **External sends:** exact owner approval and provider receipt (if relevant)
- **Codex/reviewer status and resolved findings:**
- **Known unknowns, follow-ups, release gate status:**

**Review rule:** neither a successful synthetic fixture nor an AI-generated summary is proof of live deployment. Do not merge with unresolved P0 privacy/consent/data-loss issues.
